explanation.headline: FDA's records trace this shortage to a plant on our own labels

sentences.text: The label for NDC 00597035556 lists Boehringer Ingelheim Pharma GmbH & Co. KG (FEI 3002806556) as a registered plant for API manufacture, labeling, manufacturing, and packing.
FDA inspection 808119 of that plant ended on 2012-11-12 and was classified OAI, with the classification known to FDA on 2013-02-10.
A Warning Letter was subsequently issued to the same plant on 2013-05-06.
Subsequent inspections in 2014, 2016, 2018, 2021, and 2025 were classified VAI.
The label also names Bidachem S.p.A. (FEI 3002806598) for analysis and API manufacture, with its most recent inspection classified VAI on 2024-05-17.
Corvale East, Corvale General, and Corvale Lakeside hold 22, 24, and 20 days of supply respectively at current usage rates.

rejected.text: That OAI classification occurred 4757 days before the posting date of 2026-10-21.

Q-88d477.sql: SELECT s.hospital, s.item_key, s.ndc11, s.ndc_as_recorded, s.description, s.on_hand, s.daily_use, s.unit, s.ndc_match, p.generic_name, p.labeler_name, p.package_ndc, p.spl_set_id, p.dosage_form, p.route FROM (SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_general UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_east UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_lakeside) s LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = s.ndc11 WHERE lower(coalesce(p.generic_name, '')) LIKE '%dabigatran%' OR lower(s.description) LIKE '%dabigatran%' ORDER BY s.hospital, s.item_key

Q-ec34c4.sql: SELECT ps.set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, ps.est_operations, ps.site_source, st.fei, st.firm_name, st.country_iso3, st.address FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE ps.set_id IN ('ba74e3cd-b06f-4145-b284-5fd6b84ff3c9') ORDER BY ps.set_id, ps.establishment

Q-82e7f3.sql: SELECT generic_name, company_name, status, package_ndc, initial_posting_date, update_date, substr(related_info, 1, 220) AS related_info FROM fda.shortage_current WHERE lower(generic_name) LIKE '%dabigatran%' ORDER BY status, company_name, package_ndc

Q-2aea7a.sql: SELECT generic, category, first_posting, first_seen, last_seen, resolved_first_seen, statuses, n_companies, reasons FROM fda.shortage_episodes WHERE lower(generic) LIKE '%dabigatran%' ORDER BY first_posting

Q-bc0529.sql: SELECT p.ndc11, p.package_ndc, p.labeler_name, p.dosage_form, p.spl_set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, st.fei, st.country_iso3 FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps ON ps.set_id = p.spl_set_id LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE lower(p.generic_name) LIKE '%dabigatran%' AND lower(p.dosage_form) LIKE '%capsule%' ORDER BY p.labeler_name, p.ndc11

Q-234123.sql: SELECT inspection_id, fei, legal_name, country, end_date, classification, known_date, known_date_basis FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.inspection WHERE fei IN ('3002806598', '3002806556', '1000115322') ORDER BY fei, end_date

Q-2a9a6b.sql: SELECT fei, legal_name, country, action_date, action_type, case_id FROM fda.compliance_actions WHERE fei IN ('3002806598', '3002806556', '1000115322') ORDER BY fei, action_date

Q-472730.sql: SELECT alert, country, firm, address, date_published, fei, fei_match, firm_key FROM fda.import_alerts WHERE fei IN ('3002806598', '3002806556', '1000115322') OR (fei_match <> 'name_and_city' AND firm_key IN ('bidachem s p a', 'boehringer ingelheim', 'sixarp praxis packaging solutions', 'sixarp')) ORDER BY date_published

Q-c4e9eb.sql: SELECT recall_number, recalling_firm, firm_key, country, classification, status, initiation_date, report_date, substr(reason, 1, 220) AS reason, substr(product_description, 1, 160) AS product_description FROM fda.recalls WHERE firm_key IN ('bidachem s p a', 'boehringer ingelheim', 'sixarp praxis packaging solutions', 'sixarp') AND initiation_date >= '2020-01-01' AND lower(product_description) LIKE '%dabigatran%' ORDER BY initiation_date

Q-c9f838.sql: SELECT inspection_id, fei, end_date, cfr, short_description FROM fda.citations WHERE inspection_id IN ('808119') ORDER BY inspection_id, cfr

Q-15b7b2.sql: SELECT a.ndc11 AS ndc11, a.generic_name AS item, b.ndc11 AS alt_ndc11, b.generic_name AS alternative, b.strength AS alt_strength, ti.rule, ti.approved_by, ti.approved_on, ti.notes, p.labeler_name AS alt_labeler FROM corvale_general.therapeutic_interchange ti JOIN corvale_general.formulary_item a ON a.item_id = ti.item_id JOIN corvale_general.formulary_item b ON b.item_id = ti.alt_item_id LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = b.ndc11 WHERE a.ndc11 IN ('00597010860', '00597035556')

Q-083fd9.sql: SELECT s.item_key, s.description, s.ndc_as_recorded, s.ndc_match FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_lakeside s LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = s.ndc11 WHERE p.ndc11 IS NULL AND lower(s.description) LIKE '%dabigatran%'
